card.name: Inside neuromuscular blocker and sympathomimetic names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a drug-class name just before the word agents or drugs, mainly neu|rom|uscular blocking and sympath|om|imetic. It also fires on neuro in neuroleptic.

modes.label: Neuromuscular blocking agents
modes.description: The 'rom' piece inside neuromuscular, ahead of blocking agents.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage with neu<<rom>>uscular blocking agents may result in neu

modes.label: Sympathomimetic drugs
modes.description: The 'om' piece inside sympathomimetic, ahead of drugs.
modes.example: Fatalities have been reported in association with excessive use of inhaled sympath<<om>>imetic drugs.

modes.label: Neuroleptic drugs
modes.description: The word neuro at the start of neuroleptic, before drugs.
modes.example: the total cumulative dose of<< neuro>>leptic drugs administered to the patient increase

card.writes: It suppresses pill and drug words, so the next piece is likely to finish the long class name rather than a generic drug word.
card.plain: It marks the middle of long drug-class names like neuromuscular blocking agents and sympathomimetic drugs.
